column1: #   <comma list>  — those packages get a NESTED vendored copy of their own
#                   resolved version (pnpm store realpath), keeping today's
#                   runtime bits; everyone else gets the top-level winner.
#   -             — RESOLUTION-UNIFORM: declarations are disjoint on paper but
#                   the workspace lockfile resolves ONE version for every
#                   declarer; the build VERIFIES each declarer's actual
#                   resolution satisfies the winner, then unions top-level only.
# Rationale: aligning declarations by editing package.json files would CHANGE
# what the monorepo installs (@linear/sdk 60→64 is a behavioral change) and is
# out of scope for the distribution layer (byte-compat red line). A NEW
# disjoint conflict NOT registered here fails the build.
# zod: manifests in teamlead/terminal-mcp still say ^3.23.0 but the pnpm store
# holds ONLY zod@4.3.6 — production runs zod 4 everywhere today.
